description: This file defines interfaces, notifiers, and data structures for the RLC (Radio Link Control) transmission layer in a wireless communication protocol stack. It includes classes and structs for handling SDUs, buffer states, and communication between upper and lower layers of the RLC entity, specifically for the transmission (TX) side.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs from upper layers for transmission, with indication if it is a retransmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards SDUs identified by their PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: on_transmitted_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layer of transmitted SDUs and their sequence numbers.

methods.name: on_delivered_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layer of successfully delivered SDUs.

methods.name: on_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layer of retransmitted SDUs.

methods.name: on_delivered_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Notifies upper layer of successfully delivered retransmitted SDUs.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Indicates a protocol failure to the upper layer.

methods.name: on_max_retx
methods.description: Indicates maximum retransmissions reached to the upper layer.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Pulls an RLC PDU from the lower layer for transmission.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state of the RLC TX entity.

methods.name: on_buffer_state_update
methods.description: Updates the buffer state to the lower layers.
